utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Eli, I’m a bit late—what’s left to do for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Glad you’re here, Dane. Start with the donations by the garage, then we’ll load the last boxes together.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it—I’ll head to the garage and get the donations sorted.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, Tess — I’ll be there Sunday around 9 at the community center and ready to help.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, Sam — Sunday at 9 at the community center works great, and I’ll let folks know you’re coming.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Tess — I’m looking forward to it and I’ll be there Sunday at 9 at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So it’s still happening, right? You’ll send the details soon?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, it’s still on. I’ll send the details soon.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Alright, just checking — you’ll send them over when you’ve got them, right?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — Sunday at the community center is the latest update. I’ll keep an eye out for the next locations.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, thanks, Opal — I’ll spread the word that it’s Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll keep tracking the next stops and share them as soon as they come in.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How far along are we on the repair drive, Oren?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m a bit foggy on the exact tally, Mina, but I’m on it and I’ll get you the latest count soon.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Oren — I’ll wait for the latest tally.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep, it’s on — go ahead and tell people. I’ll keep you posted as folks reach out and let us know what they can bring.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, so you’re really handling the follow-up and keeping track of who offers what, right?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep, I’ve got the follow-up covered and I’ll keep track of who offers what. Just send folks my way, and I’ll coordinate the pieces.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good, Noah — just send the location over when Opal confirms, and I’ll be ready to help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Mara — I’ll send the location as soon as Opal confirms. Appreciate you keeping an eye on the donations.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Of course, Noah — happy to keep an eye on the donations, and I’ll be ready once Opal confirms.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Mara — I’ll keep an eye out for the details and help sort the list once it comes in.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Leo — I’ll send the details and sign-up list over soon. Appreciate you helping keep the repair drive organized.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll sort the list as soon as it comes in.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard you’re short on duct tape, a Phillips screwdriver, and a few spare screws, so I’ll keep an eye out for those.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Nell — that’d be a big help. Just bring anything you find by when you can.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I will — I’m hearing those are the main things you need, so I’ll drop them by if I find any.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Vik — once you send the timing and who’s bringing what, I can check what I can cover too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll send the timing and the bring-list over, and I’m still planning to bring my tools by the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, thanks — that’ll make it much easier to plan. I’ll watch for it and see what I can cover once it’s sent.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help with quieter tasks Sunday at the community center instead. I’m available around 9, and I can bring a few basic tools.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, Sunday at 9 works. Can you bring the screwdriver set and gloves?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, I can bring the screwdriver set and gloves on Sunday at 9.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I can grab the duct tape, a Phillips screwdriver, and some spare screws.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, thanks Bo — that should get us set for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, glad that helps — I’ll bring them by.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira — what time is the repair drive, and do we still need hands, tools, or any spare supplies?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still checking the time, but we could use more hands and a few spare tools and supplies. I’ll let you know as soon as I’ve got the exact details.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira — please let me know the exact time as soon as you have it. I can help with hands, and I’ll keep an eye out for any spare tools or supplies too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got the spare drill and screwdrivers ready, and I’ll check the battery tonight. I still need to confirm the repair drive time and the remaining supplies.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus — please let me know the time and any remaining supplies once you confirm them.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Will do — I’ll check tonight and let you know the time and what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Opal — I’ll keep an eye out for the update.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s moved to Sunday at the community center. I’ll send along anything else if it changes.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — Sunday at the community center. Thanks, Opal, I’ll keep an eye out if anything else changes.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m still planning to bring my tools by the repair drive and help where they need it most.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh good, I’ll watch for your update on what they need most first.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep, I’ll bring my tools by and report back on what they say needs the most help.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 9:30 Saturday still works for me after the school run. Thanks, Gus — the drill and screwdrivers will be perfect.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect — I’ll bring them by 9:30 Saturday after the school run.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks Gus — I’ll see you then after the school run.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, thanks Dane — that should get us set for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Glad to help, Cleo—I'll swing by late and check in on anything else you need.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Dane — I’ll keep an eye out and let you know if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, right — it’s moved to Sunday at the community center now. I’ll keep it quiet and let you know if anything else changes.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess. Sunday at the community center works for me — I appreciate you keeping it quiet.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Of course, Uli — I’ll keep it quiet and let you know if I hear anything new about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Sam — the biggest needs are still a few broken steps, a leaky faucet, and a loose railing. Since the drive is Sunday at the community center now, I’ll post the updated details and bring the list for volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, I’ll help match volunteers to the steps, faucet, and railing so we can stay organized on Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Sam — that’ll help a lot. I’ll make sure the updated list and sign-up sheets are ready for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely, I’ll keep spreading the word while I’m out and point folks your way if they can lend a hand, tools, or spare supplies.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Ira — I really appreciate you keeping an eye out and pointing folks our way. That’ll help us fill the last few spots for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: You got it — I’ll keep an ear out and send anyone willing to help your way while I’m running errands.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, thanks, Pia — I’ll keep an eye out and check the numbers on my end. If you need me to do anything else, just remind me.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Oren — I’m still putting the list together, and I’ll send it over as soon as I can. If anything changes on timing or supplies, let me know so I can keep it straight.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Of course, Pia — just send it when you’re ready, and I’ll take it from there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll send the invite out right away so everyone knows it’s Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — I’ll be there Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll get the full details sent out soon, and thanks for being there Sunday at the community center!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ll be there Sunday at the community center, and I can bring tools for the roof leak or broken window. Just show me the urgent spots when I arrive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thank you, Rey—that’s a big help. I’ll point you to the roof leak and broken window first on Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, I’ll see you Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Faye — that works for me. I’ll be ready right around pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, I’ll send the schedule over and keep it right after the school run.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Faye — I’ll watch for it and be ready right around pickup time.
